It's possible that you may have had a relatively easy time in undergraduate school, but graduate school is a different level of academic rigor. It's essential to be prepared for the increased demands and challenges that come with pursuing a graduate degree. It's always a good idea to research and understand the specific requirements and expectations of the graduate program you're interested in, as well as talk to current students or professors to get a better sense of what to expect. This will help you set realistic expectations and prepare yourself for the challenges ahead.
